BrochureContent.Content: Situated on an elevated site in an area of outstanding natural beauty, this detached bungalow enjoys uninterrupted panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Puffin Island, and the Skellig Islands. Nestled along Ireland's renowned Wild Atlantic Way and just a short distance from the Ring of Kerry, the property offers a peaceful and private setting surrounded by some of the country's most spectacular scenery. The scenic fishing village of Portmagee, complete with pubs and restaurants, are also nearby.

Extending to c. 122 sqm, the property offers excellent living space both inside and out. While well maintained and presented in good condition throughout, it would benefit from some modernisation, allowing the new owner the opportunity to create a truly special coastal home.

The accommodation comprises a bright living room featuring a large picture window that perfectly frames the stunning sea views, together with an insert wood-burning stove creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen/dining room is located just off the living room and a practical utility room is positioned adjacent to the kitchen.

There are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including the master bedroom with ensuite bathroom. One of the bedrooms is currently being used as a lounge/home office, offering flexibility to suit a variety of lifestyle needs. A family bathroom completes the accommodation.

An attached garage provides valuable storage space and offers further potential. 

Outside, the property sits on c. 1.06 acres, with the grounds primarily laid to lawn, providing ample space for recreation, gardening, or simply enjoying the breathtaking surroundings. A spacious driveway offers generous parking.

This stunning coastal location is celebrated for its rugged beauty, dramatic landscapes, and wealth of outdoor activities, including walking, swimming, fishing, and boating. Whether seeking a permanent residence, a holiday home, or an investment opportunity, this property represents a rare chance to acquire a home in one of Kerry's most sought-after coastal settings

The property is located on the beautiful coast line of St Finian’s Bay and is within a short distance of the beach and the villages of Ballinskelligs and Portmagee. Ballinskelligs and Portmagee are both beautiful seaside villages along the coast of Kerry. Caherciveen town is only 15 minutes away by car and offers plenty shopping facilities, cafes, restaurants and bars while the larger towns of Killorglin and Killarney can be reached in c. 1 hour and 1.5 hours, respectively.

The property is within easy reach to the airports in Cork, Shannon and Kerry which offer direct transport links within Ireland as well as to Europe and the UK.

The immediate vicinity is ideal for sailing, walking, fishing or playing golf. Various championship golf courses such as Dooks Golf Course and Waterville Golf Course, which are some of the best courses in Ireland, are close by.
